text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 3:2 (approximately 1.500:1), target canvas 1536 × 1024 pixels.

Landscape 3:2 three-panel photographic head identity turnaround, equal-width panels separated by fine vertical white lines. One fictional adult Theo, age 26, with fair skin, dark almost-black center-parted wavy hair curling beside temples, gray-green eyes under thick brows, angular cheekbones, strong moderately square jaw, straight medium-length nose and natural full lips. Left panel exact 90-degree profile looking left; center panel perfectly front-facing at eye level, upright head, level eyes and balanced shoulders; right panel opposite 90-degree profile looking right. One consistent skull, nose, chin, eyes, hairline and head scale through all rotations. Entire hair crown to upper chest visible in each panel. Neutral closed mouth, relaxed brows, no smile or flirtatious expression, no glasses or hat. Visible collar: plain white crew-neck T-shirt. 85mm lens perspective, sharp face and gentle background separation. Plain matte cool-gray studio wall and gray floor, soft cool blue-gray daylight and even fill, subtle fine film grain, real pores, fine facial hair, matte skin and real fabric weave. Photographic live-action casting reference, no stylized 3D, no wax skin, heavy retouching, strong warm tint, drama lighting, text, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt: Produce a LANDSCAPE 3:2 high-resolution photographic head identity turnaround of the exact same original fictional adult character Theo, age26, in the reference. Preserve face identity exactly: his original dark wavy center-part hair, grey-green eyes, angular but youthful cheekbones/jaw; closed neutral lips, no smirk. THREE equal panels: left = exact 90-degree profile nose pointing LEFT edge; center = pure FRONT EYE-LEVEL passport-style neutral face, eyes level, head upright without tilt or yaw, shoulders level; right = exact opposite 90-degree profile nose pointing RIGHT edge. All panels same physical skull and facial geometry, equal head size and hair top/upper-chest crop. Side nose/chin/ear silhouettes must correspond to center rather than inventing a new face. Expression completely neutral, lips softly CLOSED, relaxed brows, no smiling, no posed flirting, no looking down. plain white crew neck tee collar. No glasses, no hat. Background plain matte cool grey studio wall, soft cool blue-grey natural daylight and balanced fill, 85mm portrait, real pores/skin texture, fine film grain, quiet realistic live action. No wax/plastic/oily/CG/anime, no beautification or deaging. No text, labels or watermark. Only angle/expression/collar/background may change, identity is fixed.
